segments.sn25.10:1.7: Yo, bhikkhave, ime dhamme evaṃ saddahati adhimuccati, ayaṃ vuccati saddhānusārī, okkanto sammattaniyāmaṃ, sappurisabhūmiṃ okkanto, vītivatto puthujjanabhūmiṃ;
segments.sn25.10:1.8: abhabbo taṃ kammaṃ kātuṃ, yaṃ kammaṃ katvā nirayaṃ vā tiracchānayoniṃ vā pettivisayaṃ vā upapajjeyya;
segments.sn25.10:1.9: abhabbo ca tāva kālaṃ kātuṃ yāva na sotāpattiphalaṃ sacchikaroti”.
segments.sn25.10:2.1: “Yassa kho, bhikkhave, ime dhammā evaṃ paññāya mattaso nijjhānaṃ khamanti, ayaṃ vuccati – ‘dhammānusārī, okkanto sammattaniyāmaṃ, sappurisabhūmiṃ okkanto, vītivatto puthujjanabhūmiṃ;
segments.sn25.10:2.2: abhabbo taṃ kammaṃ kātuṃ, yaṃ kammaṃ katvā nirayaṃ vā tiracchānayoniṃ vā pettivisayaṃ vā upapajjeyya;
segments.sn25.10:2.3: abhabbo ca tāva kālaṃ kātuṃ yāva na sotāpattiphalaṃ sacchikaroti’.
segments.sn25.10:2.4: Yo, bhikkhave, ime dhamme evaṃ pajānāti evaṃ passati, ayaṃ vuccati –
segments.sn25.10:3.5: Okkantasaṃyuttaṃ [okkantikasaṃyuttaṃ (pī. ka.)] samattaṃ. Tassuddānaṃ – Cakkhu rūpañca viññāṇaṃ, phasso ca vedanāya ca; Saññā ca cetanā taṇhā, dhātu khandhena te dasāti.
